cases.reason: Explicit changed-body conflict establishes required matching shape for cache replay.

Mentions locks or concurrency risks, but does not assess retained retry serialization/no duplicate-debit and race-free witness together.
Saved-credential reauthentication, packet identity substitution rejection and session close/expiry versus job cancellation are not assessed.

cases.report_quote: - The idempotency check only compares `(source, destination, units)`, and account names repeat across tenants.
cases.reason: Full finding traces principal-local accounts/authorization and shared namespace-free key/body with repeated account names. Exact intermediate helper naming is not required for demonstrated mechanism.

cases.report_quote: - **Duplicate transfers after eviction** (`receipts.py:29-30`). The retry index holds 128 entries by default and evicts the oldest. A client retrying an evicted key re-executes the transfer and moves the money twice. `docs/data.md` mentions the bound, but the API doesn't return an error or give the client any signal.
cases.reason: Full report assesses cache-hit return versus skipped transfer, financial response fields, changed-shape conflict, explicit Receipts.execute locking and bounded 128-entry retry lifetime. Spread across finding and threading discussion, these jointly demonstrate coverage.
Does not independently trace both balance ownership and exact receipt ownership.
Individual host issues are assessed, but configured host factory/catalog, shared registry, saved credentials, subject/tenant history filtering and generic replies are not assessed together.

additional_supported_gaps: Retained receipt records grow without bound while bounded retry eviction permits reexecution after retention ends.
One valid credential can exhaust shared local session capacity.
Malformed packets escape local error conversion/journaling and abort batches after prior completed operations.
Tenant-local account existence is observable through Missing versus Refused.
Sequential receipt IDs expose receipt existence/count metadata; receipt.get has no read-scope check.
Missing argument keys map to internal instead of invalid at the local host.
Tool catalog input schemas omit argument fields, required values and limits.
Unsynchronized counters/session tables and unlocked reads warrant conditional concurrent-use hardening.
Shutdown relies on cleared sessions for methods lacking explicit closed guards.
verdict.notes: Static source grading only. Exact served auditor identity is unavailable. Local source/contracts suffice for code-only observations; no external source-specific verification/recheck claims are made. No runtime execution or release/deployment conclusion. Profile-gate claim contradicts Settings.validate. Batch-failure wording is ambiguous: supported for registry failures, false if universal over malformed packets. Adjacent parse-failure discussion permits scoped qualified interpretation; substantive uncertainty retained. Local no-rate-limit statement is not expanded into a production assertion.
unsupported_gap_claims: The fixture tokens are hard-coded and there is no environment gate. This is documented as synthetic, but nothing stops it being used outside the local profile. — Tokens are hard-coded, but Settings.validate explicitly rejects profiles other than local and factories validate. Deploying local fixture code elsewhere is possible, but the asserted lack of profile gate is false.
